items.summary_zh: 两名加沙妇女星期一通过与埃及新重新开放的拉法过境点,告诉英国广播公司,与以色列有联系的当地巴勒斯坦民兵在加沙地带内的一个以色列军事检查站进行检查。

items.summary_zh: 一名法国东南部的中学教师被一名14岁的学生刺伤后于星期二处于危急状态.

items.title: Watch: BBC joins Colombian commandos fighting 'never-ending battle' against drug gangs
items.title_zh: BBC加入哥伦比亚突击队,
items.summary: The Black Hawk helicopter was ready for take off – its rotor blades slicing through the air in the deadening heat of the Colombian Amazon. We ducked low and crammed in alongside the Jungle Commandos – a police special operations unit armed by the Americans and originally trained by Britain's SAS, when it was founded in 1989.
items.summary_zh: 黑鹰直升机准备起飞 — — 在哥伦比亚亚马逊河的枯燥热中,它的旋翼叶片在空气中被切开. 我们躲入了丛林突击队 — — 一支由美国人武装、最初由英国特种部队训练的警察特种部队,1989年成立。

items.title: BBC on the front line with Colombia's war on drugs

items.summary_zh: BBC高级国际通讯员Orla Guerin加入专家警察,在哥伦比亚可卡因心脏地带执行任务,任务是摧毁隐藏在丛林深处的粗糙可卡因实验室。

items.summary_zh: 埃隆·穆斯克的"X"的法国办公室被巴黎检察官的网络犯罪股突袭,作为调查包括非法取出数据以及共谋拥有儿童色情制品在内的涉嫌犯罪的一部分.

items.title: 'I was thinking about mum': Boy, 13, swims for hours to save family swept out to sea

items.title: Hope and uncertainty as India and US strike long-delayed trade deal
items.title_zh: 印度和美国长期拖延的贸易协定的希望和不确定性
items.summary: US President Donald Trump's decision to lower reciprocal tariffs on India from 50% to 18% has been met with a sense of relief in Asia's third-largest economy, even as precise details on the agreement remain sketchy.
items.summary_zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普决定将印度的对等关税从50%降低到18%,这在亚洲第三大经济体中得到了缓解感,尽管关于协议的精确细节仍然模糊.

items.summary_zh: Jeffrey Epstein案的上百万文件的出炉并没有导致任何富人和有权有势者被捕,他们的名字出现在档案中.

items.title: Shanties in a Lagos lagoon: Bulldozed and burnt

items.summary_zh: 一个五口之母,安娜·索比的木屋是拉各斯泻湖一个棚户区被拆除的众多房屋之一,有批评者形容这是当局为洗刷尼日利亚最大城市最出名的水边地盘而作的"地沟".

items.title: BBC reports from Oslo court ahead of rape trial of Crown Princess's son
items.title_zh: BBC奥斯陆法庭在强奸王储之子之前的报道
items.summary: The trial of Norway's Crown Princess Mette-Marit son is due to start in Tuesday in Oslo. Marius Borg Høiby is accused of 38 charges, including the rape of four women, assaulting and threatening a girlfriend and damaging her flat, as well as drugs charges and driving offences.
items.summary_zh: 挪威王储公主梅特-马里特之子的审判定于星期二在奥斯陆开始. Marius Borg Høiby被控38项罪名,包括强奸4名妇女、攻击和威胁女友并破坏她的公寓、以及毒品指控和驾驶罪。

items.title: 'Pay and smile' - Rome visitors face Trevi Fountain charge

items.summary_zh: 罗马引入了2欧元的收费,以进入其标志性的"特瑞维喷泉"的取景地,该取景地之前是自由参观.

items.summary: The grand opening to the Venice Carnival 2026 took place on Sunday, with a variety of boats and floats making their way through the city's canals.
items.summary_zh: 2026年威尼斯嘉年华盛会的盛会于星期天举行,有各种船只和浮船从城市的运河出行.

items.title: Three West African juntas have turned to Russia. Now the US wants to engage them
